Definition: Aphek (or Aphik), the name of three places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Aphek or Aphik = "enclosure"; 1) a Canaanite city near Jezreel; 2) a city in territory of Asher; 3) a city northeast of Beirut in Transjordan
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
